parsed.public_message: Green's neutrality offer is refused. White stays with Orange and Blue; Green is the only enemy. Alexander will stand on the west rim, inside the ring, and will not strike Orange or Blue while Green stands. Peeling off to chase one hero lets the other army hit you in the back.

private_messages.Claude: Pact holds. Only Green is enemy. Alexander is moving to the west rim at (575,685), clear of your swords. I will not attack Orange while Green stands.
private_messages.Gemini: Stay on Green. Alexander is moving to (575,685), west of your line, so your archers and elephants have a clear shot northeast. Ally to you, enemy only to Green. The Green blob in sight is archers and Ptolemy near (702,714), on the ring edge.

parsed.notes_to_self: T19 t575 ONLY Alex 75%. Squad table is truth (archers/cav gone). Move (575,685) standground, ~79m from centre; ring is 90 from t600, keep future posts inside 80m of (640,640). Seen: Gemini d(643,646) full eles+comps+archers ~72m after move; GPT c(702,714) 26 ranged+Ptolemy 92% at ~96m from centre, burns ~t593 unless they step to ~(690,700); Claude a(689,629) ~40 melee, b cav(590,629). Hold ally Claude, ally Gemini, enemy GPT. Do not flip. Next: if GPT up stay W no chase; if GPT dead hold and let Orange vs Blue bleed, no first swing. If set enemy or blob <45m, opposite rim inside 80m. Never leave r=90. Win=last alive; 500 hero loses to any army.
parsed.explanation: Alexander is the last white unit, so he walks to the west rim before the ring locks at 90 m and before he is standing in Blue's melee or Green's archery. He will stand there and keep Orange and Blue as allies while those armies grind Green down. One wounded hero does not win a trade with either giant; the win is still being alive when they break each other.
